releaseNotes:
- Release Center can now be completed from the keyboard and stays usable at 200% zoom.
- Interrupted production can resume from the suggested next step, first checking the original paid task so work is not submitted twice.
- Large project uploads now split into safe batches and keep the original transfer protocol after a restart, instead of silently falling back to the old path.
- Publishing now uploads only the missing project files more reliably, including very large media, without loading the whole book into memory.
- Story review Skills now run as independent checks alongside CLI evaluation, so leftover review work no longer blocks ordinary authoring.
releaseNotesZh:
- 发布中心现可通过键盘走完操作，并在 200% 缩放下保持可用。
- 中断的素材生产可按建议步骤恢复，并先核对原任务，避免重复付费。
- 大型项目上传会拆成安全批次，中断后仍按原协议续传，不会悄悄改成旧通道。
- 发布现会更可靠地只上传缺失的项目文件，包括超大媒体，且不会把整本书装进内存。
- 故事审查 Skill 现可与 CLI 评估并行独立执行，遗留审查工作不再打断普通创作。
